endpoint.censored_relations: excluded from this analysis; counts recorded in filter_log.csv
endpoint.rationale: IC50 and Ki are different quantities and are not pooled. IC50 in nM with an exact '=' relation is the best-populated comparable endpoint for both COX isoforms in this ChEMBL release, and matches the existing exploratory notebook.

selectivity_definition: selectivity_log10_IC50_cox1_over_cox2 = log10(IC50_COX1 / IC50_COX2) = pIC50_COX2 - pIC50_COX1; positive means stronger COX-2 inhibition
duplicate_policy: median pIC50 per molecule-target pair; spread retained and flagged when the replicate range exceeds 1.0 log units
